leanGate.meaning: lake build (+ riemann-check) green; Phase-0 sorry-free; RH remains unproved

comparison.caveat: Speedup is wall-clock of this harness/phase vs published ~30h FLT formalization baseline. Different theorem, different model stack, different agent count — methodology comparison only, not a like-for-like bake-off.

honesty.rhClaimStatus: OPEN — Riemann hypothesis is not proved in this repository

honesty.anthropic30hBaselineCharacterization: Fable 5.2 ~1000-agent FLT Lean formalization ≈28.7–30h (methodology baseline; not RH)
nonClaims: Does not claim CapEx / HBM / LLM bake-off wins
